1boy, solo, adult male, seated behind a compact drum kit, legs apart, torso leaning forward slightly, elbows near knees, each hand loosely holding one drumstick across his lap, the two sticks crossing below his hands, head turned toward screen-left, quiet tired expression,

A quiet rehearsal studio after a loud performance. Drum kit around the seated drummer, amplifiers on both sides, acoustic wall panels behind him, a guitar leaning against the right amplifier, microphone stands and floor cables.

Wide horizontal composition, full body seated at center, shoes visible. Low front view through the gap between the bass drum and cymbal stands. Foreground drum hardware partially frames him without hiding his face. Large cymbals on both sides above the toms, bass drum below his lap.

Single warm overhead spotlight casting a pale circle on the wall behind him, warm light on his face and hands, narrow golden sheen along cymbal edges, surrounding amplifiers fading into shadow. Muted olive, gunmetal and warm ivory colors, stillness after a performance.
